rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the single fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Amounts print the writer's official text (1,234.56) in one text cell. On this 1999 sheet rows 14-17 expose only some columns as fillable cells (14-16: C and E; 17: C, D, E); row 18 exposes A-E. Unexposed columns stay blank on print; the submitted XML always carries them. Item 13 'If yes, specify' prints the relief name from derived:line:tax_relief_specify (Form2553Draft::to_print_field_map); the upload keeps the option code. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Since #113 every value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason; the unexposed row 14-17 columns are listed there.
